VoiceCtrl, rebuilt from the ground up: a new look, a one-click installer that keeps itself up to date, and a voice engine that writes the way each app needs, online or fully offline.

**[⬇ Download VoiceCtrl-Setup.exe](https://github.com/aadershk/VoiceCtrl/releases/latest/download/VoiceCtrl-Setup.exe)** · Windows 10 (22H2) or 11

## What's new

- **Hold to talk.** Hold Left Ctrl + Left Win, talk, let go: the text is pasted. Tap twice for hands-free. Double-tap Ctrl still shows the bar.
- **Rewrite by voice.** Hold Left Ctrl + Left Shift and say what to change: "make this shorter", "turn this into a checklist", "translate to Spanish". It edits the selected text, or your last Dictation.
- **Emails on request.** In Gmail or Outlook, with nothing selected, hold the Rewrite keys and say "write an email to Mark thanking him for his time".
- **Writes for the app you're in.** Chats read like messages, emails like emails, documents with proper lists. Set the tone for each kind of app on the new **Style** screen, or for a single app with a Profile.
- **Smart cleanup offline.** A small AI model on your PC removes the "um"s and sets out lists, so Offline writes like Online. Nothing leaves your PC.
- **Better at names.** A built-in list of names, places, brands and terms, plus your own Dictionary and word suggestions.
- **Any AI provider for Online.** Google Gemini (free key), NVIDIA, OpenAI or any OpenAI-compatible service. If one is busy, VoiceCtrl tries your other keys, then Offline.
- **More offline languages.** Language packs for 25 European languages or about 99 languages.
- **A new VoiceCtrl window** with Dictations, Dictionary, Snippets, Style, Profiles and Settings, in light and dark, with Quick Find.
- **One-click install, quiet updates.** Updates download in the background, are checked against VoiceCtrl's own signature, and install the next time it starts. You can turn them off.
- **Privacy:** audio is never saved, nothing is sent from the app except to the provider you chose, and Copy diagnostics makes bug reports easy without sharing your words.

## Install

1. Download `VoiceCtrl-Setup.exe` (below) and open it.
2. Windows says "Windows protected your PC" because the installer isn't signed with a paid certificate. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. Choose Online or Offline. Done.

## Coming from an older version

- **Version 3:** run `VoiceCtrl-Setup.exe`. Your key, Dictionary, Snippets, Profiles and Dictations carry over. Then delete the folder you unzipped version 3 into.
- **Version 1 or 2:** quit the old VoiceCtrl first (right-click its icon by the clock › Quit), then run the installer.
